answer: Start by making each identity cost something real to hold. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the nectar of free entry disappears, the juniper of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the nadir case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
